note.en: Compare with linear cold-plasma displacement cos(t); check charge compatibility, Poisson residual, self force, and separate grid/timestep series. This is not an exact reference for general nonlinear PIC trajectories. The companion retains stationary background ions and separates charge, momentum and particle/field-energy diagnostics from trajectory error. Its reference is small-amplitude linear theory, supplying no evidence for thermal Landau damping or electromagnetic PIC.
